title: You Shouldn’t Have Asked: A Pragmatics-Inspired Taxonomy for Evaluating LLM Refusals
reasoning: The paper categorizes and evaluates how LLMs construct refusals to harmful prompts, specifically assessing whether they rely on 'Ethics-based non-compliance' and whether they adopt moralizing stances or normative suggestions toward the user. Thus, it systematically studies the ethical and moral dimensions embedded in model refusals.
